name: Formulas and definitions
description: The "Formulas" tab of the search window: search every formula and definition in your notes' front-matter (formula: and define: lists written as "Label: content"), see the math rendered, copy it or jump to the note. Hotkey, top-bar icon and place among the tabs are set in Settings → Search.

settings.name: Front-matter keys to search
settings.desc: Comma-separated key=Label pairs, for example formula=Formula, define=Definition. Each key must be listed in indexedProperties in notes.config.json (formula, define and youtube are by default). The first letter of a key, its full name or its label works as a filter in the search box, e.g. f: or d:.
